text: Terraform provider for managing incident.io configuration as infrastructure-as-code
quote: We're working through our Terraform provider resource by resource to make your infra-as-code setup easier to understand and maintain.

text: Alert sources can shard rate limits using a query expression that extracts a value from incoming alert payloads
quote: Alert sources have been updated to enable you to specify a query expression to extract a value from incoming alert payloads to shard rate limits on.

text: Declare and run incidents in seconds directly from Slack or Microsoft Teams
quote: Declaring an incident takes seconds, and you can do it right from where your team already works, whether that's Slack or Microsoft Teams.

text: Auto-generated incident timeline from key events that you can customize with your own narrative and external events
quote: Our timeline is completely customizable. We generate a simple timeline based on key events, but you can always add your own narrative or events that happened in an external system.

text: Track post-mortem completion across the org with list views, a post-incident flow, and policies
quote: Track post-mortem completion across your org with list views, the post-incident flow, and policies.

text: AI generates post-mortem first drafts, gives inline review suggestions, and redrafts sections
quote: Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.

text: Incident actions are split into immediate actions and follow-ups to complete after the incident closes
quote: We believe you create two types of actions during an incident – those that **need doing now** and those that should be followed up after an incident has been closed.

text: Follow-up work from incidents is captured and tracked through to completion
quote: Capture the work an incident leaves behind, and track it to completion.

quote: incident.io provides two APIs for status pages: the Status Page API for programmatically managing incidents and maintenance windows, and the Widget API for embedding status data into your own product.

text: Workflows automatically publish to the status page when an incident is updated
quote: With [Workflows](/workflows/getting-started), you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.

text: Public and private status pages for communicating with customers during incidents
quote: We've built an easy and delightful way to communicate with customers during an incident with our public and private Status Pages.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants query incidents, analyze alerts, check who is on call, and manage escalations

text: Scribe joins and transcribes incident calls

text: Collaborate with your team and AI to draft status page updates

text: Configure how AI-written summaries and updates are styled across the organization

text: AI Investigations automatically work out what is happening during an incident across every source at once

text: Investigations gather alerts, stack traces, similar past incidents, change events, runbooks, code changes, and telemetry when an incident is declared

text: Investigations form hypotheses, test them against code and telemetry, and refine conclusions as new evidence arrives
quote: It's a structured process that gathers evidence, forms a hypothesis, then tests that hypothesis against your code and telemetry, refining its conclusion as new evidence arrives.

text: Investigation harness pressure-tests every hypothesis with an adversarial agent before presenting it
quote: Investigations runs on a purpose-built harness that re-assesses as new signals land, builds findings from real evidence, and pressure-tests every hypothesis with an adversarial agent before it reaches you.

text: Investigations stay within user-set bounds, keep a full record of their work, and state what they do and don't know

quote: Alerts: Configure alerts from your observability tools. Escalations: Route alerts to the appropriate escalation paths, schedules, and team members. Schedules: Define who is on-call to receive escalations.

text: Over 40 ready-made alert sources plus custom HTTP alert sources
quote: We have over 40 alert sources ready to go, plus the ability to roll your own via HTTP.

text: On-call routes alerts by team, service, or other attributes
quote: On-call routes alerts by team, service, or anything else that makes sense.

text: Assign an alert source to a team regardless of payload contents
quote: Teams can now assign an alert source to a team, regardless to what is in the payload.

text: Escalation rules based on priority and working hours page the right people at the right time
quote: You can now set up rules around priority and/or working hours to ensure you page the right people at the right time without causing additional noise.

text: Create on-call schedules with rotations and chosen participants
quote: Leverage schedules to tell us who should be on-call and when. We'll walk you through all the steps to create schedules that will work for your organization's needs.

text: Schedules support single-team rotations, shadow schedules, and follow-the-sun configurations
quote: From simple single-team rotations to shadow schedules and follow-the-sun, our on-call product handles any configuration without manual workarounds.

text: Import personal time-off from calendars or HRIS via iCal and show it alongside on-call shifts
quote: you can import your team's personal holidays (time-off, vacation, PTO) into incident.io. We'll then surface those holidays alongside your On-call schedule shifts.

text: Deduplication keys prevent duplicate alerts while a matching alert is still active
quote: if alert A is received with a deduplication key "x" and alert B with the same deduplication key is received while alert A is still active... no new alert will be created for alert B

text: Related alerts are grouped so they can be triaged, escalated, and attached to incidents as one
quote: Group related alerts into an alert group so you can triage, escalate and attach them to incidents as one.

text: Flag noisy alerts with one click and find them later in the alerts list and insights
quote: Flag the alerts that waste your time with one click, then find them again in the alerts list and insights.

text: Record investigation notes, handovers, and actions on alerts without creating an incident
quote: Document investigations, hand over context, and record actions taken on alerts — without needing to create an incident.

text: Detect when a service fails silently

text: Insights dashboards answer pager load, out-of-hours paging, response time, and follow-up questions

text: Insights support custom date ranges including the current period and comparison with the previous period
quote: you can choose to include data from the current Week/Month/Quarter... You can also compare with the previous period by toggling it on.

quote: Webhooks can be used to receive notifications when certain events occur in incident.io... syncing on-call data like alerts, escalations, and schedule changes to external tools.
